The Calcutta High Court held that goods meant for exports were taken back to the factory for repair not a case of tax evasion. The appellant’s case is that the goods while being loaded into the vessel and had got damaged and as a result, the goods had to be taken back to the appellant’s factory at Ranchi for repairs. On perusal of the e-Way Bill, it is seen that no tax was payable since the goods which were owned by the appellants were taken back to their factory at Ranchi for repairs.
